# Archer Christian Academy

> Archer Christian Academy is a Christ-centered, classical Christian school opening in Fall 2027 in the Englewood neighborhood of Chicago, Illinois. It launches with kindergarten through 2nd grade (K–2), adds one grade each year through 12th grade, and caps classes at 14 students. It is a ministry of Urban Youth Outreach, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit that has served Englewood families for more than four decades.

## Key facts

- Name: Archer Christian Academy (also "Archer" or "ACA")
- Type: Private, Christ-centered, classical Christian school (nonprofit)
- Location: 672 West Marquette Road, Chicago, IL 60621 (Englewood)
- Opening: Fall 2027 with grades K–2; one grade added per year toward a full K–12 school
- Class size: 14 students per class
- Educational model: The classical Trivium — Grammar School (K–5), Logic School (6–8), Rhetoric School (9–12) — plus Applied Arts (archery and woodworking)
- Grammar-stage subjects: phonics-based reading, classic children's literature, chronological history, mastery-focused mathematics, observational science, Latin, Scripture, music, and art
- Tuition: Not a posted price. Every family contributes monthly; the amount is set individually and confidentially based on the family's resources, with the remaining cost covered by ministry partners. No mission-aligned family is turned away for financial reasons.
- Admissions: Open to families who desire a Christ-centered classical education; a church background or profession of faith is not required to apply. Four steps: conversation & tour, application & family story, partnership interview, enrollment decision.
- Parent organization: Urban Youth Outreach, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit; gifts are tax-deductible
- Mantra: "Launched true, for God and community." Motto: "sagitta vera" (true arrow)
- Executive Director: Daniel M. Bair
- Contact: daniel@archerchristian.org · 312-539-0644
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/ArcherEnglewood/ · https://www.instagram.com/archerchristianacademy/ · https://www.linkedin.com/company/archerchristian
